correctness.rationale: For p prime 1 mod 4, Paley adjacency has Fourier eigenmultiplicities 1,m,m. Tao Lemma 1.3 implies every t-by-m evaluation matrix rank min(t,m). The dissipative Hamiltonian has only the site-vanishing adjacency eigenvectors as nondecaying modes; their dimension is 2(m-t)_+. Finite-dimensional spectral contraction proves all other amplitudes decay. Strict source nonabsorption follows from full rank on T plus one site, and uniform-source efficiency from trace of dark projector. An explicit eigenvector and integer determinant 6 certify contrasting Paley(9) placements. Standalone verifier checks all t<=m subsets for p5,p13, 200 seeded p17 sets and the nonprime witness; finite checks are corroboration, not proof of all p.
